title: Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III Compact Camera
purpose: Spontaneous, high-intimacy lifestyle and travel snapshot photography with natural skin warmth, built-in ND filter versatility, deep 1-inch sensor depth of field, and direct on-camera flash character.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III (20.1MP 1.0-Type Stacked CMOS)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 20.1MP 1.0-inch stacked CMOS sensor with DIGIC 8 image processor
sensor_and_optics.lens: Integrated 8.8-36.8mm f/1.8-2.8 IS Lens (24-100mm FF equivalent, 4.2x optical zoom, built-in 3-stop ND filter)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 12.5 stops dynamic range with 14-bit CR3 RAW capture
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic/mechanical leaf shutter up to 1/25,600s, 1/2000s flash sync, whisper-quiet actuation

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Direct on-camera pop-up flash or vibrant golden-hour travel ambient light
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Signature Canon warm tonal roll-off, vibrant reds and amber hues, specular highlight sheen with rapid inverse-square flash falloff in dark interiors

surface_rendering: Authentic Canon color science: flattering warm skin tones, lifelike epidermal translucency, and natural rosy undertones without synthetic beauty smoothing
Crisp optical micro-contrast across casual textiles, café tabletops, street food textures, and intimate environmental details
Clean DIGIC 8 demosaicing with honest micro-grain and zero heavy-handed digital denoise smearing
depth_and_optics: Deep environmental focus inherent to 1.0-type sensor physics, keeping both subject and immediate background context in sharp narrative legibility at f/2.8-f/4.0
Gentle circular optical bokeh when shooting close-up macros at 24mm f/1.8 or 100mm f/2.8
Spontaneous, eye-level or chest-level pocket camera framing with slight wide-angle peripheral intimacy

execution_directive: Enforce 20.1MP 1-inch stacked CMOS snapshot aesthetic, spontaneous pocketable framing, deep environmental depth of field, authentic Canon warm skin tones, and honest direct-flash or golden ambient light, shot on Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III.
